_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Base-rate coil (score rarely breaks ±2 in 12h windows) plus neutral funding and rangebound price keep the rung pinned; crowded longs are tension, not yet a directional breaker.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial: analyst explicitly HOLD/coil; narrative silent on forward path but long-skew data supports staying cautious rather than adding risk
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC remains rangebound, F&G holds 50-62, funding near flat, no sustained ETF inflow revival
next_move.invalidated_if: Range break that drives F&G outside 47-62 or a decisive ETF-flow/long-liquidation move that forces the score into Anxiety or Panic
